subject: a family's height is its neighbour pitch: on each chain tiled with its best-scoring whole domains, a domain between two neighbours advances the chain by half its centre-to-centre spacing to each, projected on the axis through them; a domain with one neighbour by half that spacing plus half its own extent along the axis; the family takes the median over three or more instances, and only a family never seen beside a neighbour falls back to the box dimension along its called axis; every height uses instances covering at least 80% of the Pfam model, three or more, and a composite model spanning two or more whole domains of other families side by side carries no height, so the domains it covers are the ones counted
assertion: the sum of pitches along a chain is its end-to-end length, so domain counting sums to the measured height of a string; a modelling rule of this work

subject: the surfaceome is every reviewed human protein with a UniProt extracellular topological domain or GPI anchor, kept inclusive; each protein carries a classification (UniProt subcellular location class and transmembrane count; the SURFY random-forest surface call, score and false-positive class; the Almen functional class; Cell Surface Protein Atlas evidence; CD number) so a stricter surface set is a stated filter rather than a change of definition
assertion: UniProt topology and subcellular-location annotation; SURFY predicts a 2,886-protein human surfaceome from 131 features per topological domain with 93.5% accuracy; the CSPA records proteins observed at a cell surface by mass spectrometry; the Almen classification sorts human membrane proteins into receptors, transporters, enzymes and miscellaneous by function and evolutionary origin

subject: an ectodomain's folded height is the longest dimension of the inertia-axis bounding box of its AlphaFold v6 model cut to residues with pLDDT of 70 or more; runs of 20 or more residues below 70 inside the span, and 5 or more at either end, are treated as disordered

subject: a disordered segment (MobiDB regions merged with the low-pLDDT runs) contributes the root-mean-square end-to-end distance of a worm-like chain of 0.4 nm per residue, with the persistence length interpolated between 1 nm for a bare chain and 8 nm for a dense glycan brush by glycan grafting density, the crossover set by side-chain crowding with no fitted parameter; consecutive segments pool into one chain
